title: Local mirror actions QuickPick review
target: Local mirror actions, SCM local-only and metadata-only remote update expectations, and evidence limits
reviewFocus: Confirm the Local Mirror Actions QuickPick still exposes sync, compare, and SCM handoff without a direct upload action.
Review SCM local-only update expectations: after a saved local mirror .md/.growi-mirror.json edit, Source Control can show Local Changes without pressing compare and without calling the GROWI API.
Review activation/startup scan expectations: pre-existing local mirror edits under .growi-mirrors are detected from .growi-mirror.json without requiring a new save event.

Review metadata-only remote check expectations: Check GROWI Updates is an SCM repository action that checks page metadata only, while Compare Again remains the full compare path that may fetch body and open diff evidence.

Review TreeView-triggered remote check expectations: opening a page, directory page, or prefix root page from TreeView can check that single page metadata only and may create GROWI Changes / Conflicts even when SCM was empty.

Review automatic remote access limits: local-only LocalChanged pages and TreeView page-open operations can trigger metadata-only checks, but there is no interval polling, no prefix-wide automatic scan, max 25 pages per automatic run, one page per TreeView operation, concurrency 2, and 10 minute per-page cooldown.

This harness does not directly trigger VS Code file watcher, activation scan, focus events, or native SCM menu rendering; use the scenario metadata together with mirrorLocalChangeMonitor, mirrorRemoteMetadataCheck, package config, and bootstrap unit evidence.
uxReviewQuestions: Does the captured QuickPick make it clear that Compare with GROWI / Compare Again remains the path for accurate GROWI-side changes and conflicts?
Is the evidence pack explicit that automatic Local Changes can come from either save-event watcher behavior or activation/startup scan behavior?
Is the evidence pack explicit that TreeView page-open metadata checks are one-page, metadata-only, and user-operation-triggered?
Is the evidence pack explicit that Check GROWI Updates is metadata-only and does not replace full compare for body diff review?
Is the SCM action set coherent: Compare Again, Check GROWI Updates, Apply to GROWI, Take into Local, Prepare LLM Local Mirror Prompt, Prepare LLM Local Mirror Diff?
